title: Evaluating the Construct Validity of Text Embeddings with Application to Survey Questions
reasoning: The study uses survey questions related to religious beliefs (e.g., a concept triad involving 'believe God') and social norms/morals (e.g., 'child respect parents', 'women children') as part of its synthetic dataset. It then evaluates how well different text embedding models capture the semantic properties of these concepts, which constitutes an evaluation of how these models represent faith and moral-related topics.
